caption_L2L3: There was an ongoing decline from 2009 to 2011. From 2011 there was sustained growth until 2016. There was a small decline from 2016 to 2018 but this has been followed by further growth until 2019. Overall level of GDP across sectors has increased from 0.4 in 2009 to over 0.5 in 2019.
